messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "oral suspension in children 2 years and older: 0.125 mg/kg orally once a day (to a maximum dose of 7.5 mg/day)"
set: ["oral suspension in children 2 years and older: 0.125 mg/kg orally once a day (to a maximum dose of 7.5 mg/day)", "oral disintegrating tablets in children 60 kg or greater: 7.5 mg orally once a day", "take orally once a day", "shake oral suspension before measuring a dose", "initial dose 10 mg orally once a day", "once a day", "maximum is 400 mg a day", "do not exceed 37.5 mg a day for infants and children under 2 years", "8 mg taken orally 2 times a day", "maintenance dose 10 to 20 mg orally once a day", "taken once a day", "take once a day", "8 mg oral dose administered twice a day for patients 12 years and older", "shake the oral suspension (liquid) before you measure a dose", "taken as one dose once a day", "do not exceed 100 mg a day for children 2 to 12 years"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
